checks.name: available/unavailable model readiness is explicit and prevents unsupported submissions
text selection survives tab navigation; literal acceptance edits only the durable draft
lost decision response replays the exact request ID/body without a duplicate revision
cell review uses the selected table coordinate and preserves leading-zero strings
page review supports sequential replace/keep/uncertain decisions without auto-confirming the page or creating OCR candidates
editor undo invalidates old visual proposals and disables stale acceptance
authenticated JSON, Markdown and XLSX downloads contain traceable review records
queued review cancellation and original-snapshot retry complete without spawning GPU inference
small-laptop and narrow viewport have no horizontal document overflow

scope: Synthetic model catalog and deterministic inference; real API, storage, edits, history and exports. No model accuracy, speed, or GPU claim.
